subject: Annual pen test & red team SOW — NetShield proposal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Trent <oliver.trent@netshieldsec.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Annual pen test window & scope (FY26 renewal)

Hi Oliver,

Hope you had a good weekend. Our annual penetration test window is coming up and we wanted to get the SOW / pricing for:

- External web app pen test (prod) — full black-box
- Auth & session management review
- One day red-team exercise (targeted)
- Follow-up verification for remediations (2 weeks after fixes)

Can you confirm availability for late April / early May and send an updated SOW with dates, deliverables, and SLA for report delivery? Also include any SOC2-friendly evidence packages you provide.

We'd like the quote for two options: (A) standard annual test + red-team day, (B) same but with accelerated 3-business-day report turnaround.

Thanks — Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Oliver Trent <oliver.trent@netshieldsec.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test window & scope (FY26 renewal)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the details — we can do both options. Attached is a draft SOW (NetShield_SOW_v2.pdf) that includes:

- Scope and test cases for external web app, auth/session, and a one-day red team
- Timeline (3 weeks from test start to draft report; 1-week for final after comments)
- Optional 3-business-day expedited report (premium fee)
- Evidence package checklist for SOC2 auditors

Two quick notes:
- We recommend adding an interactive review session with your engineering lead (Vivek?) on delivery day to walk through exploit reproductions.
- Standard exclusions are listed in section 4; we can expand to include specific IP ranges or cloud assets as required.

[Attachment: NetShield_SOW_v2.pdf (28 KB)]

Let me know which option you prefer and any contract/legal points we should be aware of.

Best,

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test window & scope (FY26 renewal)

Laura / team,

Quick technical notes after scanning the SOW:

- Please ensure the scope explicitly excludes our internal CI/CD runner IPs; those are ephemeral and will skew findings.
- For the red team day, prefer a targeted exercise on session fixation and business-logic bypass; avoid credential stuffing unless scoped.
- We should request reproduction steps in the draft report for any critical findings (not just PoC).

I'd be OK with Option A unless budget allows accelerated turnaround for critical issues. Happy to join the interactive review.

Cheers,
Vivek
Sr Engineering Manager, Platform
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Adding legal ask from Evelyn: can we get a clause for non-production data handling and confirm they won't retain screenshots or database extracts beyond 30 days? Also, we need confirmation of their subprocessor list (if any).

Evelyn, any additional contract redlines we should flag before Laura sends the SOW to legal?

- Dev

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Trent <oliver.trent@netshieldsec.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test & scope (FY26 renewal)

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the SOW. We have a few requested edits before legal review:

1) Add explicit exclusion of CI/CD ephemeral runners and our staging cluster (we'll provide a list of IP ranges).
2) Include reproduction steps (for critical/high) and target remediation verification within 2 weeks of receiving patch notes.
3) Data handling clause: delete screenshots and extracts within 30 days and confirm no retention of PII beyond what is necessary for reporting.
4) Provide your current subprocessor list and SOC2 report reference.

We prefer Option A (standard timeline). Please update the SOW and send a clean version for signature. If you can include a brief SLA appendix for report delivery (we've attached a template), that would be helpful.

Regards,
Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Trent <oliver.trent@netshieldsec.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual pen test & scope (FY26 renewal)

Laura — thanks for the clear feedback. Attached: an updated SOW (NetShield_SOW_v2.pdf, revised), plus our SLA appendix and a redlines summary.

Highlights:
- CI/CD and staging exclusions added (section 3.2) — we'll honor the provided IP list.
- Reproduction steps required for any Critical/High findings included; remediation verification window set to 2 weeks for verified fixes.
- Data handling clause added: all screenshots/extracts containing customer data will be purged within 30 days; we retain a hash-only record for auditability.
- Subprocessor list and SOC2 report reference attached; if you want a copy of the SOC2 report under NDA we can provide it.

If everything looks good we'll issue a final DocuSign and send invoice/PO instructions (PO_5678.pdf placeholder attached). If you need one small language tweak for the SLA timing, flag it and we'll incorporate it quickly.

[Attachments: NetShield_SOW_v2.pdf (29 KB); Redwood_NetShield_SLA_Appendix.docx (12 KB); PO_5678.pdf (4 KB)]

Oliver
Director, Professional Services — NetShield Security
